description: Ministry of Industry and Commerce - Authorizing the purpose for which "Sri Lanka Vedesha Bauddha Wandana Gaman Sanvidayakayange Sangamaya" as a purpose to which the powers and facitilies of the Societies Ordinance be extended
categorisation: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize a society's purpose and grant a specific exemption from a section of that Ordinance. The content is primarily about the application and modification of a legal/regulatory framework, specifically concerning the registration and regulation of societies. While a minister's name is mentioned, it is in the context of exercising statutory powers, not detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" and "regulatory frameworks."
